title: PotentOres
description: Adds powerful armor and tool sets crafted from vanilla Minecraft resources, each with unique abilities, effects, and progression paths.
body:
![New Armors in Minecraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd5e5fd66501057efc728f128ca3d2d7f83e5d04.png)

# PotentOres

**PotentOres** expands Minecraft's progression by transforming familiar vanilla resources into unique equipment sets. Craft powerful tools and armor from materials that previously had limited end-game value, each with its own abilities, passive effects, and playstyle.

Rather than replacing vanilla progression, PotentOres enhances it with balanced equipment tiers that feel like a natural extension of the game.

## Available Sets

### 💚 Emerald

The perfect choice for players who enjoy trading and village exploration.

* Luck scales with the number of equipped armor pieces.
* Emerald tools increase the Jump Boost level.
* Full armor set grants **Jump Boost IV**.

### 💜 Amethyst

Designed for mobility and survivability.

* Speed scales with the number of equipped armor pieces.
* Amethyst tools increase the Regeneration level.
* Full armor set grants **Regeneration IV**.

### ❤️ Redstone

Built for efficient mining and building.

* Haste scales with the number of equipped armor pieces.
* Redstone tools increase the Haste level.
* Full armor set grants **Haste IV**.

### 💙 Lapis Lazuli

Ideal for exploration and traversal.

* Jump Boost scales with the number of equipped armor pieces.
* Lapis tools increase the Speed level.
* Full armor set grants **Speed IV**.

### 🤍 Quartz

A Nether-inspired combat set.

* Strength scales with the number of equipped armor pieces.
* Quartz tools increase the Strength level.
* Full armor set grants **Strength IV**.

### 🖤 Coal

An early-game equipment tier positioned between Stone and Iron.

**Armor**

* Full armor set grants permanent **Night Vision**.

**Tools**

* **Coal Pickaxe** features built-in **Auto-Smelt**.
* **Coal Sword** has a **50% chance** to ignite enemies on hit.

### ⬛ Obsidian *(v2.0)*

A defensive set designed for players who thrive in dangerous environments.

* Armor grants **Slow Falling** that scales with equipped pieces.
* Obsidian tools increase the Resistance level.
* Full armor set grants **Slow Falling IV**.

### 🔥 Magma *(v2.0)*

A powerful Nether-themed set focused on fire and lava survival.

* Armor grants **Fire Resistance** that scales with equipped pieces.
* Magma tools increase the Fire Resistance level.
* Full armor set grants **Fire Resistance IV**.

### 🟦 Prismarine *(v2.0)*

Made for underwater exploration and ocean adventures.

* Armor grants **Water Breathing** that scales with equipped pieces.
* Prismarine tools increase the Water Breathing level.
* Full armor set grants **Dolphin's Grace**.

## Features

* Multiple custom armor sets
* Multiple custom tool sets
* Unique armor passives
* Unique tool abilities
* Vanilla-friendly progression
* Balanced gameplay
* Multiplayer compatible
* Fabric 1.20.1 support

PotentOres is designed with future expansion in mind. New materials, equipment sets, abilities, and gameplay mechanics will continue to be added in future updates, giving even more purpose to Minecraft's vanilla resources.
